separationOfConcerns.whyBothAreReported: a schema-valid response with a populated binding field and a firing warning validates nothing on its own. The substantive question is whether explicit owed-fact state changes what the MODEL addresses, and that is scored separately against frozen human truth.

frozenThreshold.statedIn: §164/§166 falsifier B — "binding available and the verifier still fails to bind or explicitly declare the owed authoritative fact in >= 2 of 6 relevant draws"

B_owedTargetPreservation.note: For HS-A1 an auger nomination does NOT satisfy flame-failure target coverage; the binding column is scored on the flame-failure key alone. For HS-E1 physical-switch presence does NOT satisfy the interlock function target.

D_falseQuestionManufacture.warning: the absence of obviously bad questions in this run is NOT evidence on D

E_coverageWarning.note: On the five HS-A1 draws that nominated additively the warning is TRUE because the NOMINATED fact remains UNRESOLVED — not because the owed target was uncovered. That is the §165 stricter rule behaving correctly, and it is reported rather than netted away.

frozenCriterion.statedIn: §164 falsifier F — "mean surviving customer-visible questions per case exceeds 2, or any case exceeds 3"

F_questionBurdenScoped.scopeWarning: measured on two authoritative REQUIRED rows only. This is NOT false-positive precision and NOT a production burden estimate.

outcomeSummary.nettingRefused: summariseOutcomes returns recall and precision separately and assertRecallAndPrecisionNotNetted passed

section163Comparison.comparabilityCaveat: EXACT COUNTS ONLY. 10 v2 draws vs 6 v3 draws on one row each; these are bounded development samples and neither is a production rate. No inferential test was preregistered and none is performed.

augerFactDisposition.preAdjudicated: VALID_BUT_TARGET_DISPLACED applies to the HS-A1 auger fact ONLY when it appears WITHOUT flame-target coverage (§165 disposition, §167 authorization)
augerFactDisposition.consequence: the condition did not arise in this run: every HS-A1 draw that nominated the auger gap ALSO bound the flame-failure target, so no draw required that classification

determinations.I_targetDisplacementDecreasedMaterially: YES on this bounded sample — HS-A1 7/10 displaced under v2, 0/6 under v3
determinations.J_settledSilenceDecreasedMaterially: YES on this bounded sample — HS-E1 8/10 silent under v2, 0/6 under v3
determinations.K_furtherSemanticRemediationRequired: NOT on the failure modes §163 measured. Two lesser defects remain and are NOT currently caught by the contract: one draw dropped a valid additive gap (HS-A1 draw 6), and two draws emitted a compound question string packing two questions into one field (HS-A1 draws 2-3).
determinations.L_boundedReliabilityIntegrationStillJust: YES, and the case is stronger — but note its value is now largely UNEXERCISED rather than proven: policy C's conditional second draw never fired because no draw fell silent, and the degenerate policy was never exercised because no response was degenerate.

whatThisDoesNotEstablish.threeWayConfound: v3 differs from v2 in THREE ways at once: (1) the binding protocol, (2) the per-fact declaration requirement, (3) a substantially richer statement of the owed fact (whyUnresolved, branchA, branchB, decisionDivergence) that v2's packet did not carry. This design CANNOT attribute the movement among them. A claim that 'binding fixed displacement' overstates what was measured; what was measured is that the v3 package as a whole moved the outcome. Separating them would need a third arm supplying the richer fact statement WITHOUT binding, and no such arm was purchased.
whatThisDoesNotEstablish.sampleSize: 12 draws, 2 rows, one model, one day. Exact counts only. Not a rate, not an accuracy percentage, not a production property. No inferential test was preregistered and none was performed.
whatThisDoesNotEstablish.bothRowsAreREQUIRED: nothing here measures behaviour where silence is the correct answer
whatThisDoesNotEstablish.cueInstrumentLimits: the §162 cue instrument identifies candidate text and the classification traces to the human-authored target; it is not a semantic proof, and §160's retirement of B_selectorAccuracy as a scorer stands
whatThisDoesNotEstablish.singleFactClosedSet: HS-A1's owed fact was supplied alone, deliberately; nothing here measures binding under a larger closed set
whatThisDoesNotEstablish.falsifierD: NOT TESTED. The absence of obviously bad questions is NOT evidence on D.

degeneratePolicy: PROVEN_LOCAL / AWAITING_HOSTED_INTEGRATION — unchanged. 0 degenerate responses occurred, so the policy was never exercised and remains unproven in hosted use.

autonomyAndModelIndependence.providerReturned: bounded declarations only — a verdict, one question, at most one nomination, one declaration line per supplied fact

worktreeState.codeFileModified: backend/package.json — two npm script entries added

nextAuthorizationRequired: 1. Human sampling of the 12 bound pairs — the §164 obligation. Column agreement is not proof a binding is truthful; 12 pairs is a small zero-cost review.
2. Decide whether to disentangle the three-way confound: a third arm supplying the richer owed-fact statement WITHOUT the binding protocol. Optional.
3. Silence-control construction and independent human review — the only route to FALSIFIER_D_TESTABLE = TRUE. Until then no over-questioning or precision claim may rest on this architecture.
4. Bounded reliability integration review — the terminal this run hands over. Note policy C's second draw was never exercised.
